disqualifier.note: statementType is an optional 1.97(e) discriminator with a None default, not a sibling boolean. Schema permits present true with type none and present false with type none; in-repo constructors never exclusive-write the pair. Fixtures that set both together are one producer, not proof the flag duplicates payload presence. The inventoried [sizeFeeAssertionPresent, statementPresent] pair remains a separate independent-observation cluster.

hasBlankPage is an independently observed blank-placeholder parse marker; page is an optional locator. toBlueBook prefers the flag when true but still accepts flag false with page none as an empty slot, so the flag does not duplicate presence. Combined-true is representable and unguarded. Distinct from the inventoried [unpublished, hasBlankPage] pair.

isRange is a parse marker covering page or paragraph ranges; endPage and endParagraph are optional locators. Schema does not require an end when isRange is true, and tests construct isRange false without ends. No in-repo exclusive writer. Distinct from the inventoried [isRange, starPage] orthogonal pair.
